newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end slightly up after brief fall.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end slightly up after brief fall.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended slightly up on Friday after they fell briefly on concern about a late tumble in the rupiah due, brokers said.
They said sustained buying in blue chip Telkom and Bank Negara Indonesia lifted the Jakarta Composite Index by 0.50 points, or 0.07 percent, to 724.00 points.
Shortly before the close it had fallen to 720.93 points.
In morning trading the index touched a high of 726.49 points and by the end of the day losers led gainers by 72 to 49, with 70 counters unchanged on a volume of about 487 billion rupiah.
"The market was a little bit nervous for a few minutes before the closing when the rupiah tumbled to 2,500 rupiah," Suharto, a broker with Bhakti Investama, said.
He said the tumbling rupiah sparked further selling in Citra Marga, Semen Gresik and some other small stocks before the index rebounded at closing time.
Brokers attributed the rebound to sustained buying in heavily weighted Telkom and blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia which kept the index to stay in the positive territory.
Brokers expected trading would be more active next week on the expectation that the listing of four new companies would boost market sentiment.

Chemical firm Lautan Luas, synthetic yarn producer PT Panasia Filamen Inti, Lippo General Insurance and property firm Lippo Cikarang were scheduled to be listed on the Jakarta bourse on July 21, 22 and 24 respectively.
"I believe market sentiment will be more positive next week as some investors are likely to buy back more blue chip stocks," Basar Sibarani, sales of Asian Development Securities, said.
However, brokers said concern about the Indonesian rupiah could also put some pressure on the stockmarket sentiment.
Chicken restaurant franchisee Sierad Produce topped the active list with about 36 million shares, but falling 25 rupiah on profit-taking, brokers said.
Blue-chip Indocement was also the target of profit-taking after it made strong gains on the announcement of a proposed spinoff and sale of its 50.1 percent shareholding in PT Indofood Sukses Makmur.
It was last traded at 4,450 rupiah, a drop of 375 rupiah on a volume of 4.9 million shares.
